comparison.objective: Adjust a cabinet hinge side screw to equalize reveals, then close the flap door; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat and turn a screwdriver in the correct adjustment cam, assess coupled door geometry, close, and release versus bimanual pouring and granular screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Door must close with 3–6 mm reveals differing by ≤1 mm, flush within 0.6 mm, still and released for 1 s; excessive sag from loosening the clamp permanently fails. Candidate requires complete transfer, ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill/contamination/damage, and 3 s released support. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Mechanism adjustment to a measured final alignment is a different tested ability from dry media/workpiece separation.
